description: This file contains unit tests for the MigraDoc library, specifically testing the 'SpaceBefore' formatting feature in PDF document generation. It sets up a test class with setup and teardown methods, and a test method that creates a minimalistic document, applies formatting, renders it to PDF, and performs some output operations.

classes.name: SpaceBeforeTests
classes.description: A test class for validating the 'SpaceBefore' paragraph formatting feature in MigraDoc PDF documents.

methods.name: SpaceBeforeTests
methods.description: Constructor initializing the test environment and resetting PDFsharp core settings.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Teardown method resetting PDFsharp core settings after tests.

methods.name: Tests_for_SpaceBefore
methods.description: Unit test method that creates a minimal document, applies 'SpaceBefore' formatting, renders to PDF, and optionally displays or saves the output.

methods.name: CreateDocument
methods.description: Static helper method that creates a minimalistic MigraDoc document with formatted paragraphs and headers to test spacing features.
